get_world_size: get the world size of the distributed process group or return 1 if not initialized
cat_all_gather: gather tensors from all processes and concatenate them along dimension 0
init_distributed_training: initialize per-machine process groups for distributed training across multiple GPUs and machines
get_local_rank: get the rank of the current process within the local per-machine process group
GroupGather: perform all gather and sum across local GPU groups with support for multiple sync groups
